method: RAGAS-style retrieval metrics at top_k=3, ground truth only, no LLM. Relevance: chunk is relevant iff its doc_id equals the item's expected_doc (doc-level labels; no chunk-level labels exist in the eval set).

definitions.context_precision: RAGAS: sum_k P@k * v_k / sum_k v_k over the top-3 ranked chunks; v_k=1 iff chunk k is relevant. Rewards relevant chunks ranked early.
definitions.context_recall: Relevant chunks retrieved in top-3 / total chunks in the expected doc. Ceiling at top-3 is min(3, N)/N (see max_recall_at_k).
definitions.max_recall_at_k: Mean over scored items of min(3, N)/N -- the best recall achievable at top-3 given doc sizes.
definitions.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant chunk (doc-level), 0 if none in top-3.
definitions.hit_at_1: Share of scored items whose top-1 chunk is from the expected doc.
definitions.hit_at_3: Share of scored items whose expected doc appears anywhere in top-3.
definitions.refusal_handling: The 20 no_answer items are excluded from every retrieval-metric denominator (n_scored=80 per full run); refusal is a gate decision, counted separately as refusal_correct/refusal_total per mode.
